title: Pan-Seared Myeongnan Roe with Korean Spices
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish featuring pan-seared myeongnan roe, served with a side of low-carb tagine and garnished with korean spices.
instructions: 1. Heat the luscious olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
2. Season the myeongnan roe with salt and pepper.
3. Add the myeongnan roe to the pan and sear for 2-3 minutes per side.
4. Remove the roe from the pan and set aside.
5. Add the korean chili flakes to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
6. Add the low-carb tagine to the pan and stir for 2-3 minutes.
7. Serve the pan-seared myeongnan roe with the korean-spiced tagine.
8. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
